QuestInfo.name: A Man and His Furs
QuestInfo.0: Go meet Scadur in El Nath.
QuestInfo.1: Scadur wants to get a brand-new fur coat so he can get rid of his old one. He asked you to bring the finest set of materials for his new, finest fur coat.
QuestInfo.2: I helped Scadur make the finest fur coat available in Ossyria.

0.0: You look pretty tough. Tough enough to appreciate a man who enjoys a good fur coat!

yes.0: I knew you'd be interested. Here's the situation. Lately it's been even colder than usual, and I need to make myself a much better fur coat than the one I am wearing right now to combat the coldness.
yes.1: That's why I'd like you to gather up the materials for a fur coat. I could definitely use some muscle on that job, and don't worry, I'll reward you very handsomely. What do you say?
yes.2: To make a new fur coat, I'll need #b50 #t4000048# items and 50 #t4000055# items#k. That's the price of quality!

no.0: Okay, so what's the pointing of saying no now?

1.0: Incredible! You brought all of them! Now I can spend the rest of the icy winter break wearing my fur coat and relax.

yes.0: Thank you so much. Here, please take it. I don't need it anymore.

item.0: You still haven't found all the materials for crafting my new fur coat! I'm freezing here! I need #b50 #t4000048# items and 50 #t4000055# items#k.
